text:
### 6.1 Audit Methodology  
**Planning Phase:**
- Define audit scope and objectives
- Risk assessment for target process
- Interview key personnel
- Document process workflows
- Identify key controls  
**Fieldwork Phase:**
- Test key controls (sample transaction review)
- Conduct interviews
- Analyze data and findings
- Document evidence
- Assess control effectiveness  
**Reporting Phase:**
- Draft audit report (findings, conclusions)
- Present findings to management
- Management response and action plan
- Final report issued
- Executive summary to Board Audit Committee  
**Follow-Up Phase:**
- Monitor management's remediation progress
- Re-test key controls (if major findings)
- Quarterly status update to Board Audit Committee

raw_entities.name: Board Audit Committee
raw_entities.description: The Board Audit Committee receives executive summaries of audit reports and quarterly status updates on management's remediation progress. It serves as the primary governance body overseeing internal audit activities and follow-up actions.
context: Executive summary to Board Audit Committee
Quarterly status update to Board Audit Committee

raw_entities.name: Internal Audit
raw_entities.description: The internal audit function executes a structured four-phase audit methodology comprising planning, fieldwork, reporting, and follow-up phases. It is responsible for testing key controls, documenting evidence, and monitoring management's remediation of audit findings.

raw_entities.name: Audit Scope and Objectives Definition
raw_entities.description: A planning phase action item to define the audit scope and objectives for target processes under review. This establishes the boundaries and goals of the audit engagement.

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment for Target Process
raw_entities.description: A planning phase action item to conduct risk assessment for the target process being audited. This identifies key risk areas that will inform the audit scope and testing priorities.

raw_entities.name: Key Personnel Interview
raw_entities.description: A planning phase action item to interview key personnel involved in the target process. This gathers process knowledge and identifies control owners and process stakeholders.

raw_entities.name: Process Workflow Documentation
raw_entities.description: A planning phase action item to document process workflows for the target process. This creates a baseline understanding of how the process operates and where controls are embedded.

raw_entities.name: Key Control Identification
raw_entities.description: A planning phase action item to identify key controls within the target process. This establishes which controls will be tested during the fieldwork phase.

raw_entities.name: Key Control Testing
raw_entities.description: A fieldwork phase action item to test key controls through sample transaction review and other testing procedures. This evaluates the design and operating effectiveness of identified controls.

raw_entities.name: Fieldwork Interview Execution
raw_entities.description: A fieldwork phase action item to conduct interviews with process participants and control owners. This gathers evidence regarding control operation and identifies any deviations or issues.

raw_entities.name: Data Analysis and Findings Documentation
raw_entities.description: A fieldwork phase action item to analyze collected data and document audit findings. This synthesizes evidence into specific observations regarding control effectiveness and compliance.

raw_entities.name: Control Effectiveness Assessment
raw_entities.description: A fieldwork phase action item to assess the overall effectiveness of tested controls. This determines whether controls are operating as designed and achieving their intended objectives.

raw_entities.name: Audit Report Drafting
raw_entities.description: A reporting phase action item to draft the audit report containing findings, conclusions, and recommendations. This formalizes the audit results for management and governance review.

raw_entities.name: Management Presentation of Findings
raw_entities.description: A reporting phase action item to present audit findings to management. This enables management to understand the findings and begin developing remediation responses.

raw_entities.name: Management Response and Action Plan Development
raw_entities.description: A reporting phase action item for management to develop responses and action plans addressing audit findings. This establishes management's commitment to remediate identified issues.

raw_entities.name: Final Audit Report Issuance
raw_entities.description: A reporting phase action item to issue the final audit report incorporating management responses. This completes the formal audit documentation.

raw_entities.name: Executive Summary Submission to Board Audit Committee
raw_entities.description: A reporting phase action item to submit an executive summary of the audit to the Board Audit Committee. This ensures governance oversight of audit results and management responses.
context: Executive summary to Board Audit Committee

raw_entities.name: Management Remediation Progress Monitoring
raw_entities.description: A follow-up phase action item to monitor management's progress in implementing remediation actions. This tracks the status of management's response to audit findings.

raw_entities.name: Key Control Re-testing
raw_entities.description: A follow-up phase action item to re-test key controls when major findings have been identified. This validates that management's remediation actions have been effective.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Status Update to Board Audit Committee
raw_entities.description: A follow-up phase action item to provide quarterly status updates to the Board Audit Committee on management's remediation progress. This maintains ongoing governance visibility of audit follow-up activities.
context: Quarterly status update to Board Audit Committee
